senses.zh_definition: Cyril：男子名，中文常译“西里尔”；尚未核实小写 cyril 具有马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Cyril, a male given name; no Malay common-word sense has been verified for the supplied lowercase form.
senses.ms_definition: Cyril ialah nama khas lelaki; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处为专名说明，非 DBP 官方释义。所列 IPA 是英语读音，不代表统一的马来语读法；具体人物的读音以本人为准。输入包未提供音节和爪夷文，故保留 null。下列组合为教学示例，未认定为高频搭配。英语姓名及读音依据：[Oxford：Cyril](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cyril)。

etymology.historical_story: Cyril is recorded by Oxford as a boys' first name, with an English pronunciation beginning with an s sound. Its appearance inside a Malay sentence therefore need not represent a borrowed common noun: the sentence may simply mention a person. The supplied packet does not establish the name's historical derivation or its original referent.
